objective: Make ContextFabric the machine-enforced production boundary for active working context and retire direct legacy ownership without deleting primitives prematurely.

rulesConsidered: ContextFabric is the sole active working-context authority.
Production runtime code must not directly own or mutate active context outside the ContextFabric boundary.
Legacy ActiveContextManager and ContextOS remain implementation/reference primitives until retirement evidence is complete.
No new database or authority is introduced.
Every non-trivial change follows the Team Change Gate.

changes: Removed the direct ActiveContextManager import from CognitivePlaneEngine while retaining a deprecated compatibility alias typed through ContextFabric.
Added a production boundary verifier that rejects direct ActiveContextManager or ContextOS references outside canonical primitive files.
Added the boundary verifier to package scripts and the blocking Context Fabric workflow.
Recorded Wave D authority, migration, and retirement rules in .okf.
Confirmed repository search has no production ContextOS API consumer in the FactoryOS core surface.
Preserved legacy primitives and direct unit coverage until a later retirement wave proves safe deletion.

verificationResults.note: Fresh exact-head verification is required before merge. No CLM inference/training or ContextBench work is included.
